name: performance-profile-layout
goal: Performance profile has space above it, equal measurement row heights, and no output-size row when no output is declared.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Give the overview measurement card a normal stack gap above it, equal label/value row heights, and hide the no-output placeholder while retaining real compiled target values and reasons.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing visual-overview tests only required one full-width card and explicitly required Emitted size for units without output. Extend the same current/selected-commit scenarios with card-gap, equal-row-height and applicable-target assertions at three widths; extend existing formatter and details tests to preserve real output rows.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Frozen test commit 0dab75a9944217d17b9707ed190d1bd7d03accde: record a1d5995253bed5830661222a6939075b36e585393e6a7c13cd69db6073757e80 failed with five unit assertions and all six browser cases. Actual failures: missing profile gap, unequal row heights and spacing, and an output-size placeholder without a compiled target.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Keep the existing overview stack gap, combine scalar measurements in one equal-row grid, and preserve emitted target identity so only target none is omitted. Real artifact values and unavailable-build reasons remain. Claude Opus 5.5 made the visual edits; integration preserves the existing size iteration.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Fix 9e77909996438e35f0ce24cdac007d4c3ca7ce22; sealed green dde11e5315ae5afd6520b587b22fbb82a2e42dd3e20f467d0d375b606b38e687 passes the unchanged frozen corpus from red 0dab75a9 with 29 unit tests and six desktop/tablet/mobile browser cases. Target none is hidden, measured Wasm 18 KB and missing native-build reasons remain, and all scalar rows have equal height and spacing.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Product 9e77909996438e35f0ce24cdac007d4c3ca7ce22: frozen green passed 29 unit tests and six browser cases. Full Reports check passed format, zero-error/zero-warning types, lint, 604 tests, build and app audit. Fresh actual-page desktop/tablet/mobile captures inspected: 16px gap, four equal 44.195px rows, loaded 1440x900/920x800/390x844 inherited media, preserved purpose/six tabs, no browser errors. Root check passed format/types/lint/Rust/kernel, then 889 tests passed, 25 skipped, one baseline unit-index test failed with the same entityMeasure/entityShown definition mismatches as the pre-task log; later aggregate stages were not reached. Independent root audit has the unchanged 221-line explorer-route test against a 220-line limit. Verify stays pending. Report http://127.0.0.1:5588/reports/588c54f2-bd80-4319-9053-3223ebdfe205 remains active/unpublished; all 16 R2 asset API responses match the inspected originals by SHA-256.
